Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other
vehicle was changing lanes. The mechanism described is consistent with the wrist
injury diagnosed on imaging, which showed a distal radius fracture. Over the course of
seven visits, the patient received immobilization, orthopedic follow-up, and a graded
home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as range of
motion and grip strength improved. Physical examination revealed localized tenderness
and swelling over the distal radius and reduced grip strength on the injured side,
supporting the fracture diagnosis, while neurovascular testing and sensation remained
within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same wrsit
region in the past, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not
appear to have affected the current presentation. Billing records reflect one charge
per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated entries.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
